messages:
maya_cs: Hey team — HelixThera asked for an "evening" micro-lab next week to walk their APAC/EMEA product leads through a Private deployment demo + sandbox onboarding. They specifically want a hands-on 60m session (demo + 20m Q&A) and an optional 30m follow-up for CS-only renewal-risk triage. Can we coordinate times + facilitators? :calendar:

maya_cs: Proposed session windows (please react with :one:/:two:/:three: for preference)
- Option 1: Tue 18:00 PT / Wed 02:00 GMT / Wed 11:00 SGT (main hands-on)
- Option 2: Wed 21:00 PT / Thu 05:00 GMT / Thu 14:00 SGT (main hands-on)
- Option 3: Thu 19:00 PT / Fri 03:00 GMT / Fri 12:00 SGT (main hands-on)

maya_cs: Agenda (60m):
1) 10m — quick intro + objectives
2) 20m — Private deployment walkthrough (VPC + KMS + audit logs)
3) 15m — guided sandbox task (team completes a short migration checklist)
4) 15m — Q&A and next steps

maya_cs: Follow-up 30m (optional): renewal risk signals + playbook (CS-only), proposed immediately after main session for EMEA/NA participants. Pre-read: https://docs.redwood.ai/enablement/helixthera-micro-lab (please skim)

alex_r: I can facilitate the runtime walkthrough and lead the sandbox task. Available for Option 1 and 3. Will prep a short snippet for the KV cache demo. :thumbsup:

sam_ops: I can cover Dedicated -> Private handoff and capacity considerations. Prefer Option 2 or 3. Also: can we request HelixThera to share an example terraform snippet beforehand? Makes the sandbox smoother.

olivia_se: I can join for Q&A and help capture action items for the renewal playbook. Prefer Option 1 (earlier for EMEA). I'll also prepare a 1-slide summary of common renewal flags.

maya_cs: Great — looks like mixed availability. Can folks drop their reactions to the original message for final pick? I'll coordinate with the customer for their timezone constraints.

alex_r: quick note — for the sandbox task pls allow participants to run `redwoodctl deploy --dry-run` (they shouldn't need full creds). I'll add a short snippet to the pre-read:
```
# run locally to validate model config
redwoodctl deploy --dry-run --model helix-compat-v1 --seq-len 1024
```

sam_ops: FYI, infra will need at least a 4 GPU burst window if >8 concurrent sandboxes. I'll flag capacity on the Dedicated pool for that night.

calendar_bot: Poll created: react with :one:/:two:/:three: to vote. Results close in 24h. (Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/poll/1768800123)

maya_cs: Also can we assign someone to take meeting notes and ping for the CS-only 30m? I can take notes if Alex can run the demo. Otherwise Olivia can do notes.

alex_r: I can run the demo; Maya please take notes. I'll share the demo deck by EOD tomorrow.

maya_cs: Awesome — assigning: facilitator: alex_r, notes: maya_cs, ops escalation: sam_ops, SE support: olivia_se. I'll close the poll and confirm with HelixThera once we have 3+ votes on a slot. Thanks all! :sparkles:
